```{r ahupuaa-merge-processing}
  group_by(ahupuaa, moku, mokupuni) %>% # add all columns you want to match
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = 'drop')

  merged_polygons,
  "processed_data/merged_ahupuaa.geojson",

)

  group_by(ahupuaa, moku, mokupuni) %>% # add all columns you want to match
  filter(n() > 1) %>% # only keep groups with multiple polygons
  ungroup()

st_write(
  merged_originals,
  "processed_data/merged_originals.geojson",
  delete_dsn = TRUE
)
```

```{r one-time-ahupuaa-hierarchy}
# Function to create hierarchical structure from Ahupua'a data
create_ahupuaa_hierarchy <- function(geojson_data) {
  # Extract the data frame (removing geometry for processing)
  df <- st_drop_geometry(geojson_data)

  # Clean and standardize the data
  df <- df %>%
    select(mokupuni, moku, ahupuaa) %>%
    # Remove any rows with missing values
    filter(!is.na(mokupuni) & !is.na(moku) & !is.na(ahupuaa)) %>%
    # Remove duplicates
    distinct() %>%
    # Sort for consistent ordering
    arrange(mokupuni, moku, ahupuaa)

  # Create unique value lists
  unique_values <- list(
    mokupuni = sort(unique(df$mokupuni)),
    moku = sort(unique(df$moku)),
    ahupuaa = sort(unique(df$ahupuaa))
  )

  # Create hierarchical structure
  hierarchy <- list()

  for (island in unique_values$mokupuni) {
    island_data <- df[df$mokupuni == island, ]
    island_moku <- list()

    for (district in unique(island_data$moku)) {
      district_data <- island_data[island_data$moku == district, ]
      district_ahupuaa <- sort(unique(district_data$ahupuaa))

      island_moku[[district]] <- list(
        name = district,
        ahupuaa = district_ahupuaa,
        ahupuaa_count = length(district_ahupuaa)
      )
    }

    hierarchy[[island]] <- list(
      name = island,
      moku = island_moku,
      moku_count = length(island_moku),
      total_ahupuaa = sum(sapply(island_moku, function(x) x$ahupuaa_count))
    )
  }

  # Create summary statistics
  summary_stats <- list(
    total_mokupuni = length(unique_values$mokupuni),
    total_moku = length(unique_values$moku),
    total_ahupuaa = length(unique_values$ahupuaa),
    mokupuni_details = sapply(
      names(hierarchy),
      function(island) {
        list(
          name = island,
          moku_count = hierarchy[[island]]$moku_count,
          ahupuaa_count = hierarchy[[island]]$total_ahupuaa
        )
      },
      simplify = FALSE
    )
  )

  # Return comprehensive structure
  result <- list(
    hierarchy = hierarchy,
    unique_values = unique_values,
    summary = summary_stats,
    flat_structure = df
  )

  return(result)
}

# Function to export hierarchy to JSON file
export_hierarchy_json <- function(
  hierarchy_result,
  filename = "ahupuaa_hierarchy.json"
) {
  jsonlite::write_json(
    hierarchy_result,
    filename,
    pretty = TRUE,
    auto_unbox = TRUE
  )
  cat("Hierarchy exported to:", filename, "\n")
}

# Function to print hierarchy in a readable format
print_hierarchy <- function(hierarchy_result, max_ahupuaa_display = 5) {
  cat("=== AHUPUA'A HIERARCHICAL STRUCTURE ===\n\n")

  # Print summary
  cat("SUMMARY:\n")
  cat(
    "- Total Mokupuni (Islands):",
    hierarchy_result$summary$total_mokupuni,
    "\n"
  )
  cat("- Total Moku (Districts):", hierarchy_result$summary$total_moku, "\n")
  cat("- Total Ahupua'a:", hierarchy_result$summary$total_ahupuaa, "\n\n")

  # Print detailed hierarchy
  for (island_name in names(hierarchy_result$hierarchy)) {
    island <- hierarchy_result$hierarchy[[island_name]]
    cat(
      "🏝️ ",
      island_name,
      " (",
      island$moku_count,
      " moku, ",
      island$total_ahupuaa,
      " ahupua'a)\n",
      sep = ""
    )

    for (moku_name in names(island$moku)) {
      moku <- island$moku[[moku_name]]
      cat(
        "  📍 ",
        moku_name,
        " (",
        moku$ahupuaa_count,
        " ahupua'a)\n",
        sep = ""
      )

      # Display first few ahupua'a
      ahupuaa_to_show <- head(moku$ahupuaa, max_ahupuaa_display)
      for (ahupuaa in ahupuaa_to_show) {
        cat("    - ", ahupuaa, "\n", sep = "")
      }

      # Show ellipsis if there are more
      if (length(moku$ahupuaa) > max_ahupuaa_display) {
        cat("    ... and", length(moku$ahupuaa) - max_ahupuaa_display, "more\n")
      }
      cat("\n")
    }
  }
}

# Function to create a simple lookup table
create_lookup_table <- function(hierarchy_result) {
  lookup <- hierarchy_result$flat_structure %>%
    mutate(
      full_path = paste(mokupuni, moku, ahupuaa, sep = " > "),
      id = paste(mokupuni, moku, ahupuaa, sep = "_")
    ) %>%
    select(id, full_path, mokupuni, moku, ahupuaa)

  return(lookup)
}

# Function to search within the hierarchy
search_hierarchy <- function(
  hierarchy_result,
  search_term,
  case_sensitive = FALSE
) {
  df <- hierarchy_result$flat_structure

  if (!case_sensitive) {
    search_term <- tolower(search_term)
    search_df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        mokupuni_lower = tolower(mokupuni),
        moku_lower = tolower(moku),
        ahupuaa_lower = tolower(ahupuaa)
      )

    results <- search_df %>%
      filter(
        grepl(search_term, mokupuni_lower) |
          grepl(search_term, moku_lower) |
          grepl(search_term, ahupuaa_lower)
      ) %>%
      select(mokupuni, moku, ahupuaa)
  } else {
    results <- df %>%
      filter(
        grepl(search_term, mokupuni) |
          grepl(search_term, moku) |
          grepl(search_term, ahupuaa)
      )
  }

  return(results)
}


# Function to create dropdown/select options for UI components
create_ui_options <- function(hierarchy_result) {
  # For mokupuni dropdown
  mokupuni_options <- data.frame(
    value = hierarchy_result$unique_values$mokupuni,
    label = hierarchy_result$unique_values$mokupuni,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # For moku dropdown (will need to be filtered based on mokupuni selection)
  moku_options <- hierarchy_result$flat_structure %>%
    select(mokupuni, moku) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(mokupuni, moku)

  # For ahupuaa dropdown (will need to be filtered based on moku selection)
  ahupuaa_options <- hierarchy_result$flat_structure %>%
    select(mokupuni, moku, ahupuaa) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(mokupuni, moku, ahupuaa)

  return(list(
    mokupuni = mokupuni_options,
    moku = moku_options,
    ahupuaa = ahupuaa_options
  ))
}

# Display usage instructions
cat("=== AHUPUA'A HIERARCHY CREATOR ===\n")
cat("Functions available:\n")
cat("1. create_ahupuaa_hierarchy(geojson_data) - Main function\n")
cat("2. print_hierarchy(result) - Display hierarchy\n")
cat("3. export_hierarchy_json(result, filename) - Export to JSON\n")
cat("4. create_lookup_table(result) - Create simple lookup\n")
cat("5. search_hierarchy(result, term) - Search functionality\n")
cat("6. create_ui_options(result) - Create UI dropdown options\n")
cat("7. example_usage() - Show example code\n\n")
cat("Run example_usage() to see how to use these functions!\n")

# Load your data
ahupuaa_data <- st_read("raw_data/Ahupuaa.geojson")

# Create hierarchy
hierarchy_result <- create_ahupuaa_hierarchy(ahupuaa_data)

# Access unique values (for dashboard filters)

honolulu_ahupuaa <- hierarchy_result$hierarchy[["Oʻahu"]]$moku[[
  "Honolulu"
]]$ahupuaa

ui_options <- create_ui_options(hierarchy_result)
export_hierarchy_json(hierarchy_result, 'processed_data/ahupuaa_hierarchy.json')
ui_options
```

```{r carbon-assessment-processing}
# ==============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ==============================================================================

# Safe parallel processing configuration
MAX_CORES <- 4 # Hard limit on cores to prevent overload
MEMORY_THRESHOLD_GB <- 4 # Minimum free memory required (GB)
ENABLE_PARALLEL <- TRUE # Set to FALSE to disable parallel processing

# Detect system resources safely
detect_safe_cores <- function() {
  total_cores <- detectCores()

  # Conservative core allocation:
  # - Leave at least 1 core free for system
  # - Use at most 50% of available cores
  # - Never exceed MAX_CORES
  safe_cores <- max(
    1,
    min(
      floor(total_cores / 2),
      total_cores - 1,
      MAX_CORES
    )
  )

  return(safe_cores)
}

# Check available memory (cross-platform)
check_memory <- function() {
  tryCatch(
    {
      if (Sys.info()["sysname"] == "Windows") {
        mem_info <- system("wmic OS get FreePhysicalMemory", intern = TRUE)
        free_kb <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", mem_info[2]))
        free_gb <- free_kb / 1024 / 1024
        return(free_gb)
      } else if (Sys.info()["sysname"] == "Darwin") {
        # macOS
        mem_info <- system("vm_stat", intern = TRUE)
        free_pages <- as.numeric(gsub(
          ".*: ",
          "",
          grep("Pages free", mem_info, value = TRUE)
        ))
        inactive_pages <- as.numeric(gsub(
          ".*: ",
          "",
          grep("Pages inactive", mem_info, value = TRUE)
        ))
        page_size <- 4096 # bytes
        free_gb <- (free_pages + inactive_pages) * page_size / 1024^3
        return(free_gb)
      } else {
        # Linux
        mem_info <- system("free -g | grep Mem", intern = TRUE)
        free_gb <- as.numeric(strsplit(mem_info, "\\s+")[[1]][4])
        return(free_gb)
      }
    },
    error = function(e) {
      # If memory check fails, return NULL to skip the check
      return(NULL)
    }
  )
}

# Determine if parallel processing is safe
n_cores <- if (ENABLE_PARALLEL) {
  cores <- detect_safe_cores()

  # Check memory if possible
  free_mem <- check_memory()

  if (!is.null(free_mem)) {
    if (free_mem < MEMORY_THRESHOLD_GB) {
      warning(sprintf(
        "Low memory detected (%.1f GB free). Using single core processing.",
        free_mem
      ))
      cores <- 1
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("  Available memory: %.1f GB\n", free_mem))
    }
  } else {
    cat(
      "  Memory check unavailable - proceeding with conservative core count\n"
    )
  }

  cores
} else {
  1
}

cat(sprintf("Using %d cores for parallel processing\n", n_cores))
cat(sprintf(
  "(Total available: %d, Parallel enabled: %s)\n\n",
  detectCores(),
  ENABLE_PARALLEL
))

# Processing parameters
SIMPLIFY_TOLERANCE <- 10 # meters
CHUNK_SIZE <- if (n_cores == 1) 500 else 1000 # Smaller chunks for single core

# ==============================================================================
# STEP 1: READ AND SIMPLIFY DATA
# ==============================================================================

cat("=== STEP 1: Loading and simplifying data ===\n")

# Read input data
cat("Reading carbon polygons...\n")
carbon_polygons <- st_read(
  "raw_data/Carbon_Assessment_of_Hawaii_-_Land_Cover_-_Biome_Unit.geojson",
  quiet = TRUE
)
cat(sprintf("  Loaded %d polygons\n", nrow(carbon_polygons)))

cat("Reading boundary data...\n")
merged_mokupuni <- st_read(
  "processed_data/merged_mokupuni_ridge_to_reef.geojson",
  quiet = TRUE
)
moku_data <- st_read("raw_data/Moku_Ridge_To_Reef_(DAR).geojson", quiet = TRUE)
ahupuaa_data <- st_read("processed_data/merged_ahupuaa.geojson", quiet = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("  Loaded %d ahupuaa boundaries\n", nrow(ahupuaa_data)))

# Simplify geometries early
cat("\nSimplifying geometries...\n")
carbon_simple <- carbon_polygons %>%
  select(biome_unit) %>%
  st_simplify(dTolerance = SIMPLIFY_TOLERANCE, preserveTopology = TRUE) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  mutate(original_id = row_number())

ahupuaa_simple <- ahupuaa_data %>%
  select(ahupuaa, moku, mokupuni) %>%
  st_simplify(dTolerance = SIMPLIFY_TOLERANCE, preserveTopology = TRUE) %>%
  st_make_valid()

cat(sprintf("  Simplified %d carbon polygons\n", nrow(carbon_simple)))
cat(sprintf("  Simplified %d ahupuaa boundaries\n", nrow(ahupuaa_simple)))

# ==============================================================================
# STEP 2: PREPARE CHUNKS FOR PARALLEL PROCESSING
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n=== STEP 2: Preparing data chunks ===\n")

n_chunks <- ceiling(nrow(carbon_simple) / CHUNK_SIZE)
cat(sprintf(
  "  Dividing into %d chunks of ~%d polygons each\n",
  n_chunks,
  CHUNK_SIZE
))

carbon_chunks <- split(
  carbon_simple,
  rep(1:n_chunks, each = CHUNK_SIZE, length.out = nrow(carbon_simple))
)

# ==============================================================================
# STEP 3: SPATIAL JOIN (WITH SAFE PARALLEL PROCESSING)
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n=== STEP 3: Performing spatial joins ===\n")

# Function to process each chunk
process_chunk <- function(chunk_data, ahupuaa_boundaries) {
  st_join(
    chunk_data,
    ahupuaa_boundaries,
    join = st_intersects,
    left = TRUE
  )
}

# Process with appropriate method
if (n_cores > 1) {
  cat(sprintf("  Using parallel processing with %d cores...\n", n_cores))

  # Set up parallel processing with safety measures
  plan(multisession, workers = n_cores)

  # Add error handling wrapper
  carbon_joined_list <- tryCatch(
    {
      future_map(
        seq_along(carbon_chunks),
        function(i) {
          if (i %% 10 == 0 || i == length(carbon_chunks)) {
            message(sprintf(
              "    Processed %d/%d chunks (%.1f%%)",
              i,
              length(carbon_chunks),
              i / length(carbon_chunks) * 100
            ))
          }
          result <- process_chunk(carbon_chunks[[i]], ahupuaa_simple)

          # Explicit garbage collection every 20 chunks
          if (i %% 20 == 0) {
            gc(verbose = FALSE)
          }

          return(result)
        },
        .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      warning(
        "Parallel processing failed. Falling back to sequential processing."
      )
      message(sprintf("Error details: %s", e$message))
      plan(sequential)

      # Fall back to sequential processing
      lapply(seq_along(carbon_chunks), function(i) {
        if (i %% 10 == 0 || i == length(carbon_chunks)) {
          cat(sprintf(
            "    Processed %d/%d chunks (%.1f%%)\n",
            i,
            length(carbon_chunks),
            i / length(carbon_chunks) * 100
          ))
        }
        process_chunk(carbon_chunks[[i]], ahupuaa_simple)
      })
    }
  )

  # Clean up parallel processing
  plan(sequential)
  gc() # Force garbage collection
} else {
  cat("  Using sequential processing...\n")

  # Sequential processing
  carbon_joined_list <- lapply(seq_along(carbon_chunks), function(i) {
    if (i %% 10 == 0 || i == length(carbon_chunks)) {
      cat(sprintf(
        "    Processed %d/%d chunks (%.1f%%)\n",
        i,
        length(carbon_chunks),
        i / length(carbon_chunks) * 100
      ))
    }
    result <- process_chunk(carbon_chunks[[i]], ahupuaa_simple)

    # Garbage collection every 20 chunks
    if (i %% 20 == 0) {
      gc(verbose = FALSE)
    }

    return(result)
  })
}

cat("  Combining chunk results...\n")
carbon_with_hierarchy <- bind_rows(carbon_joined_list)

cat(sprintf(
  "  Joined %d polygon-boundary pairs\n",
  nrow(carbon_with_hierarchy)
))

# ==============================================================================
# STEP 4: HANDLE BOUNDARY CROSSINGS
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n=== STEP 4: Handling boundary-crossing polygons ===\n")

polygon_match_counts <- carbon_with_hierarchy %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(original_id) %>%
  summarise(match_count = n(), .groups = "drop")

duplicate_ids <- polygon_match_counts %>%
  filter(match_count > 1) %>%
  pull(original_id)

cat(sprintf("  Found %d polygons crossing boundaries\n", length(duplicate_ids)))

carbon_clean <- carbon_with_hierarchy %>%
  filter(!original_id %in% duplicate_ids)

carbon_crossing <- carbon_with_hierarchy %>%
  filter(original_id %in% duplicate_ids)

cat(sprintf("  Clean polygons: %d\n", nrow(carbon_clean)))
cat(sprintf(
  "  Boundary-crossing polygon instances: %d\n",
  nrow(carbon_crossing)
))

# Process boundary-crossing polygons
if (length(duplicate_ids) > 0) {
  cat("  Splitting boundary-crossing polygons...\n")

  crossing_unique <- carbon_crossing %>%
    distinct(original_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(biome_unit, original_id)

  if (n_cores > 1 && nrow(crossing_unique) > 100) {
    # Only use parallel for larger datasets
    plan(multisession, workers = n_cores)

    n_crossing_chunks <- min(n_cores * 2, nrow(crossing_unique))
    crossing_chunks <- split(
      crossing_unique,
      rep(1:n_crossing_chunks, length.out = nrow(crossing_unique))
    )

    cat(sprintf(
      "  Processing %d crossing polygons in %d chunks (parallel)...\n",
      nrow(crossing_unique),
      n_crossing_chunks
    ))

    split_polygons_list <- tryCatch(
      {
        future_map(
          seq_along(crossing_chunks),
          function(i) {
            if (i %% 5 == 0 || i == length(crossing_chunks)) {
              message(sprintf(
                "    Processed %d/%d intersection chunks",
                i,
                length(crossing_chunks)
              ))
            }
            st_intersection(crossing_chunks[[i]], ahupuaa_simple)
          },
          .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
        )
      },
      error = function(e) {
        warning("Parallel intersection failed. Using sequential processing.")
        plan(sequential)
        lapply(crossing_chunks, function(chunk) {
          st_intersection(chunk, ahupuaa_simple)
        })
      }
    )

    plan(sequential)
    gc()
  } else {
    # Sequential processing for small datasets or single core
    cat(sprintf(
      "  Processing %d crossing polygons (sequential)...\n",
      nrow(crossing_unique)
    ))

    split_polygons_list <- list(
      st_intersection(crossing_unique, ahupuaa_simple)
    )
  }

  split_polygons <- bind_rows(split_polygons_list)

  cat(sprintf(
    "  Created %d split polygons from boundary crossers\n",
    nrow(split_polygons)
  ))

  carbon_final <- bind_rows(
    carbon_clean %>% select(biome_unit, ahupuaa, moku, mokupuni),
    split_polygons %>% select(biome_unit, ahupuaa, moku, mokupuni)
  )
} else {
  carbon_final <- carbon_clean %>%
    select(biome_unit, ahupuaa, moku, mokupuni)
}

# ==============================================================================
# STEP 5: FINAL CLEANUP AND VALIDATION
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n=== STEP 5: Final cleanup ===\n")

carbon_final <- carbon_final %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  distinct()

cat(sprintf("  Final polygon count: %d\n", nrow(carbon_final)))

# ==============================================================================
# STEP 6: WRITE OUTPUT
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n=== STEP 6: Writing output ===\n")

cat("Writing GeoJSON file...\n")
st_write(
  carbon_final,
  "processed_data/carbon_biome_hierarchy.geojson",
  delete_dsn = TRUE,
  quiet = FALSE
)

cat("Creating summary CSV...\n")
biome_summary <- carbon_final %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(mokupuni, moku, ahupuaa, biome_unit) %>%
  summarise(polygon_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(mokupuni, moku, ahupuaa, biome_unit)

write.csv(
  biome_summary,
  "processed_data/carbon_biome_summary.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ==============================================================================
# SUMMARY STATISTICS
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n")
cat(strrep("=", 70), "\n")
cat("PROCESSING COMPLETE\n")
cat(strrep("=", 70), "\n\n")

cat("Summary Statistics:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Total polygons processed: %d\n", nrow(carbon_final)))
cat(sprintf(
  "  Polygons with ahupuaa: %d (%.1f%%)\n",
  sum(!is.na(carbon_final$ahupuaa)),
  sum(!is.na(carbon_final$ahupuaa)) / nrow(carbon_final) * 100
))
cat(sprintf(
  "  Polygons with moku: %d (%.1f%%)\n",
  sum(!is.na(carbon_final$moku)),
  sum(!is.na(carbon_final$moku)) / nrow(carbon_final) * 100
))
cat(sprintf(
  "  Polygons with mokupuni: %d (%.1f%%)\n",
  sum(!is.na(carbon_final$mokupuni)),
  sum(!is.na(carbon_final$mokupuni)) / nrow(carbon_final) * 100
))
cat(sprintf(
  "  Unassigned polygons: %d (%.1f%%)\n",
  sum(is.na(carbon_final$ahupuaa)),
  sum(is.na(carbon_final$ahupuaa)) / nrow(carbon_final) * 100
))
cat(sprintf("  Unique biomes: %d\n", length(unique(carbon_final$biome_unit))))

cat("\nOutput files created:\n")
cat("  - processed_data/carbon_biome_hierarchy.geojson\n")
cat("  - processed_data/carbon_biome_summary.csv\n\n")

cat("Top 10 Biomes by Polygon Count:\n")
top_biomes <- carbon_final %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  count(biome_unit, sort = TRUE) %>%
  head(10)
print(top_biomes)

cat("\n")
cat(strrep("=", 70), "\n")
```
